family.description: This family has been characterised as 3-octaprenyl-4- hydroxybenzoate carboxy-lyase enzymes [[cite:PUB00020511]]. This enzyme catalyses the third reaction in ubiquinone biosynthesis. For optimal activity the carboxy-lase was shown to require Mn2+ [[cite:PUB00020511]]. This entry represents the central RIFT-related domain.

causal_graphs.context: Recombinant AnFdc from E. coli BL21(DE3), with bound prFMN; 350 uL, 50 mM KCl and 50 mM sodium phosphate pH 6, 25 C. Cinnamic acid disappearance and styrene-assigned UV appearance are followed over time.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure 1c-d, Results and UV-Vis methods inspected; ledger S1a. Product formation is measured spectroscopically, not direct CO2 release.
evidence.snippet: conversion of cinnamic acid to styrene

edges.mechanism: Purified holoenzyme consumes the acid with a decrease at 270 nm and appearance of the styrene-assigned peak at 245 nm. The joint source includes enzyme, cofactor and substrate; none alone is asserted sufficient.
edges.subject: reaction

causal_graphs.family_mapping: A2QHE5 sequence 1/entry 95 is the 500-aa An03g06590 reference. PF01977 maps to 119-318; PF20695 to 14-103 and PF20696 to 324-460. Deposited 4ZA4 equals the reference plus LEHHHHHH. See evidence/PF01977/member-mapping.txt.
causal_graphs.limitations: Does not measure native fungal flux, isolated-domain sufficiency or the complete atomistic trajectory. UbiX supplies cofactor and is not assigned this decarboxylation. Reference taxonomy is not the expression host.

causal_graphs.context: 10 mM styrene, 100 mM sodium phosphate initially pH 6 and 3 M bicarbonate, final pH 7.5, 25 C overnight; enzyme-containing and no-enzyme samples compared by HPLC.

evidence.explanation: Original Extended Data 1 and carboxylation HPLC methods inspected; ledger S1b. No isotope-traced CO2 incorporation or physiological rate is claimed.

edges.mechanism: Enzyme addition yields the cinnamic-acid-assigned chromatographic peak absent from the otherwise matched no-enzyme styrene control.

causal_graphs.limitations: High-bicarbonate assay is not native carboxylative flux. Exact enzyme amount and full calibration are not established here. Figure A254 versus methods264 nm discrepancy is retained. Forward/reverse graphs are separate, not a biological feedback loop.

evidence.explanation: Figure 5 R173A trace, Arg173 Results and methods; ledger S2b. Refines the earlier2015 inactivity claim.

edges.subject: r173a

evidence.explanation: Figure 5 R173K trace and Arg173 Results; ledger S2b. This is a detection-bounded negative, not proof of absolute inactivity.

edges.mechanism: No R173K turnover was detected by the reported assays despite a mature-cofactor-consistent mass signal. The mutant was not crystallized, so its active-site structural effect remains unresolved.
edges.subject: r173k

evidence.explanation: Original Figures 5 and 6A/D, Results and rate methods; ledger S2b. Apparent values may reflect active-cofactor occupancy as well as chemistry.

edges.mechanism: E277D retains product formation but has apparent turnover 1.2 +/- 0.2 s^-1 versus WT 9.4 +/- 0.1 s^-1. Its substrate dependence is not Michaelis-Menten; no Km is assigned.
edges.subject: e277d

evidence.explanation: Original Figure 5 E277Q trace and Glu-variant Results; ledger S2b. Preparation-dependent cofactor adducts are an explicit alternative contributor.
evidence.snippet: only very low levels of decarboxylase activity

edges.subject: e277q

evidence.explanation: Original Figures 5 and 6A/C and Results; ledger S2b. Complete protein and cofactor preparation, not isolated-domain kinetics.

edges.mechanism: E282D retains styrene production with apparent turnover 0.63 +/- 0.04 s^-1 versus WT 9.4 +/- 0.1 s^-1, not zero activity.

edges.mechanism: E282Q has no detected cinnamate turnover under these2018 solution assays. Later trapping of a decarboxylated cofactor adduct does not establish complete catalytic turnover by this mutant.

edges.mechanism: The Results report very low exchange after 4 h with R173A, consistent with residual activity rather than an absolute loss. No precise rate or independently inspected four-hour spectrum is asserted.

causal_graphs.family_mapping: A2QHE5 version 1, PF01977 at 119-318; all three substitutions lie inside that interval. Complete enzyme retains PF20695/PF20696. Exact individual assay plasmids have not been independently resequenced.

edges.mechanism: E282D loses normalized activity with illumination relative to its dark control, despite retaining measurable turnover before exposure.

evidence.explanation: Light-dependent-inactivation Results, Figure 2B spectra and light/dark methods; ledger S2d. The five-minute activity endpoint is reported in text, not Figure 2A's ambient-light series.

evidence.explanation: Figure 2 C/D electron-density panels and adjacent crystal-isomerization Results establish the structural direction, distinct from the solution-activity experiment. Ledger S2d.

evidence.explanation: Figure 2E/F and isomerization Results, not E282Q turnover, support this edge. Ledger S2d records the directly inspected structural comparison.

causal_graphs.family_mapping: A2QHE5 version 1, PF01977 119-318; E282 is internal. The complete enzyme has additional Pfam domains; no isolated-domain photochemistry is tested.
